# Uplevyl

> Uplevyl is an AI-powered platform empowering women through CTO services, adaptive learning, collaboration tools, and a female-forward social network.

Founded by Shubhi Rao, Uplevyl combines artificial intelligence with a mission to advance women in technology and leadership. The platform offers integrated solutions for organizational knowledge management, team upskilling, community engagement, and safe digital spaces designed with women's needs in mind.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered platform
- Women in tech
- CTO services
- Adaptive learning
- Workflow automation
- Leadership development
- Knowledge management
- Community collaboration
- Digital transformation
- AI ethics
- Safety and privacy
- UpGenie
- UpHub
- UpAccelerator
- UpSocial

## Core Platform Products

- [UpGenie Knowledge System](https://uplevyl.com/knowledgesystem): UpGenie knowledge infrastructure for organizational data management and information systems
- [UpHub Collaboration Platform](https://uplevyl.com/collaborationplatform): UpHub collaboration platform with AI personalization and community management features
- [UpAccelerator Learning Program](https://uplevyl.com/adaptivelearning): UpAccelerator AI-powered adaptive learning for team upskilling and leadership development
- [UpSocial Network](https://uplevyl.com/upsocial): UpSocial: ad-free, female-forward social media platform with integrated safety features
